verdict.rationale: The realtime WebSocket API reference documents adding words to a custom dictionary, each with an array of sounds-like variants. That is a direct custom-vocabulary capability for domain terms and names, but it rests on a single thin reference line. Domain-specialized models (finance, medical) are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of custom vocabulary in batch transcription, boost weighting or intensity controls, limits on vocabulary size, in-depth feature docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy gains.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly

citations.quote: Pass an object to add a single word to the dictionary, with an array of words which it sounds like.
